description: Ministerio de Hacienda y Finanzas, Gobierno de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires publishes a georeferenced list of the buildings that belong to the Government of the City of Buenos Aires. Coverage: the City of Buenos Aires, Argentina; a snapshot the portal marks as updated "eventual" (as needed), with the record last modified on 2026-06-23. Format and access: CSV, ZIP, XLSX, downloadable without registration from the Buenos Aires open data portal (BA Data); the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): CC-BY-2.5-AR; cost: free. Caveats: the portal text is a single sentence, so the attribute fields, the building count and which agencies are included were not read; it lists government-owned buildings, not the whole building stock. Simulation uses: exposure and continuity analyses of public buildings, siting of emergency and service functions, and public asset portfolios in urban resilience models. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
name: Buenos Aires: public buildings of the city government (Edificios Públicos)
